title: STR Scout — Market Analysis (Batch Mode)
description: Run a single short-term rental market analysis. For multi-tool access (search-listings, regulations, arbitrage-score), use Standby mode and call the HTTP/MCP endpoints — see the Actor's documentation.

location.title: Location
location.description: City to analyze. Best results for major metros covered by curated open-data feeds; other cities use a live market scrape (slower).

bedrooms.title: Bedrooms
bedrooms.description: Filter to listings with at least this many bedrooms. Leave empty for all.
